Data & methodology

The replay scores banks on March 1 using financials for the previous December 31. March 1 is an assumed reporting lag. FDIC records were retrieved retrospectively and may include revisions. Review outcomes cover the following 12 months and count FDIC failure records among banks eligible to be scored.

Model fitting used year-end reports from 2007–2013, selection used 2014–2018, and the replay uses 2019–2024. Average precision summarizes how well the scores rank future failures across thresholds. Alert precision is the share of alerts followed by failure. The model’s feature impacts come from replacing one input at a time with its training median and measuring the score change. They depend on that reference value and are descriptive.

This project evaluates historical screening performance. The scores are uncalibrated and intended for ranking in the replay.
